name: New sources of discrete events from Fabric system events and Azure storage events
description: Discrete events (a.k.a. notification events) are significant (important) facts that have happened, and that trigger state changes or actions in the downstream consumer applications (subscribers). Examples include events like OrderPlaced in order system, blob storage changes in Azure sources, or item changes in Fabric system.

result.nameEs: Nuevos orígenes de eventos discretos: eventos de sistema de Fabric y de Azure Storage
